notes: GSM8K: our 4-shot full-set scores are 6-7 points under Qwen's own report. The gap is prompt format: lm-eval and the SmolLM2 card's lighteval agree with each other and not with Qwen's figure (results/compare_v0.md).
HellaSwag: its items are internal only (the Hugging Face copy states no licence). This file holds scores of public models, not items.
subset scores are for comparing checkpoints and formats; they are NOT comparable to published full-set scores
